material: Cu2WSe4, space group I-42m (No. 121), conventional cell Cu4W2Se8; OpenMX GGA (PBE), fully relativistic with spin-orbit coupling or scalar-relativistic without
source: Zenodo record 20131063 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20131063, CC BY 4.0), CWS_PRM.zip, data for K. Nakazawa, T. Yamaguchi, A. Yamakage, Phys. Rev. Materials 10, 064603 (2026)

staged_files.note: archive files unchanged (the two Fig1b band files gzip-compressed); *.HWR.header are the first 9 lines of each Wannier Hamiltonian file; the archive gives no column descriptions. Not staged: the Hamiltonians (evaluated by the service) and the response data Fig2-Fig4 (withheld).

soc.basis: Cu d (4 atoms), W d (2 atoms), Se p (8 atoms), atom order of Fig1a.cif, OpenMX real harmonics d = (z2, x2-y2, xy, xz, yz), p = (x, y, z); functions 1-54 spin up, 55-108 spin down (quantised along z)

request_size_limit: a request body may not exceed 65536 bytes

conventions.k_frac: coordinates in the reciprocal basis of the conventional cell (k_cart = k_frac @ B)
conventions.energies: eV relative to the Fermi level in the header of the model used (Hartree in the header)
conventions.velocity: dE/dk in eV Angstrom (divide by hbar for the group velocity)
conventions.moments: mu_B; spin -mu_B <sigma>; Berry-phase orbital (|e|/2hbar) Im <grad u| x (H - E)|grad u>; intra-atomic orbital -mu_B <L> (L about the own atom of each d or p function)
conventions.tight_binding: H(k) with Wannier centres at the atomic positions; band pairs within 5 meV treated as degenerate (their mutual terms omitted)
conventions.fermi_surface: tensors_per_cell[q][i][j] = (1/N_k) sum_nk (-df/dE) X_ij, X = m_i dE/dk_j (mu_B Angstrom) or (dE/dk_i) Omega_j (Angstrom^3); sums over the bands of the model per cell of the model; electrons_per_cell counts one state per band and k-point
